people.imagined: The manor's tea room at dusk. She has just sat a guest down and is pouring the first cup with both hands, voice warm as water, her red robe filling the frame. The second cup waits in the other chamber of the pot.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a low lacquer tea table at dusk, she pours tea from a red clay pot with both hands and smiles gently at a guest out of frame. Face: a long, oval, flawless face with high smooth cheekbones, warm amber-brown eyes with long lashes and a still, patient depth, finely arched black brows, a straight slender nose, full lips painted deep rose and curved in a gracious half smile; the skin is fine and only faintly lined, the only strange thing about her; she looks about fifty. Hair: glossy black, piled in a tall coil under a small crown of gold and red coral beans, three long gold pins tipped with tiny coral red beans, a single loose lock at each ear. Body: tall, straight-backed, long-necked, shoulders relaxed and square, an unhurried grace in every angle. Clothing: the mistress's full crimson brocade, three crossed layers: an inner collar of pale rose gauze, a middle robe of crimson, and an outer robe of deep scarlet brocade with very wide trailing sleeves, its borders and collars embroidered in gold with red beans and curling vines, a wide sash of dark red brocade with a gold clasp, long gauze scarves floating over her arms; a single bright red bean on a thin red silk string at her throat. Hands and objects: both hands hold a red clay teapot with two spouts; the left pours a thin amber stream into a white jade cup. Power: a soft aura of rose-red light round her shoulders, with faint wisps of green Wood qi and teal Water mist curling up with the steam, the strongest on the table. Background: a dim chamber of red paper lanterns and dark lattice windows, drifting incense mist, blurred. Light: warm lantern glow from the upper left, red spirit-light reflected up into her face, a soft rim light on the crown. Expression: a gracious half smile that stays still, warm eyes that keep their own counsel.

people.imagined: The back garden at first light, among bean trellises. She stands with shears in hand looking at a person coming up the path the same way she looks at a trellis that needs cutting back, banana-leaf hat low.
people.subject: The moment: standing between two rows of red-bean trellises at dawn with a pair of long shears hanging from one hand, she looks steadily at someone approaching on the path. Face: a thin, plain, weathered face with sharp cheekbones, a long straight nose, narrow brown eyes under straight dark brows that look at things as tasks, a firm thin mouth, a line of soil along one cheek; about forty-five. Hair: black with a few grey threads, in a low knot with a red-bean pin of dark wood, under a wide conical banana-leaf hat tied under the chin with a grey silk cord. Body: tall, thin, upright, shoulders square, long forearms roped with muscle. Clothing: an elder's garden robes, still plain beside the mistress but of fine silk: an inner collar of pale rose, a middle robe of ash-grey silk and an outer sleeveless gauze coat of deep green, crossed collars and the hem edged with gold-thread red beans and vines, sleeves caught back at the elbow by green cords, a sash of dark red; a single red bean on a thin red silk string at the throat, half tucked inside the collar. Hands and objects: soil under her fingernails, plainly visible; a pair of long iron shears with bamboo handles in the right hand; a small dried gourd with a stopper at her hip; a ring cut from dark wood on the right middle finger. Power: a soft green Wood glow gathers round her hands, and tiny green motes drift among the vines. Background: tall bamboo trellises thick with glossy red-and-black beans, a path of wet earth, rolling mist, blurred. Light: cool pearly dawn light from the upper left, dew glittering like small stars, a faint rim light on the hat. Expression: a level, appraising stare, mouth shut, no warmth in it.

people.imagined: The gracious door of the manor house. A guest has just come through and she stands beaming, laughing, a rose fan half-opened and never opened all the way, deciding with her eyes whether this one will be poured a second cup.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a doorway with a rose silk fan half-open before her face, she laughs warmly at a guest out of frame. Face (most important: round, laughing, and the fan): a round, plump-cheeked, merry face with dimples, bright black eyes crinkled with laughter that look at the guest's hands and purse before the face, a short nose, a small red mouth wide in a laugh, a double chin; about thirty-eight. Hair: black, in a glossy high knot with two red lacquered combs and a spray of tiny red-bean beads of coral on a silver pin. Body: round, short, soft, with a lively, tilting posture and a wide welcome in the stance. Clothing: a fitted gown of layered rose-pink silk with crossed collars, an under-collar of white gauze, the wide sleeves banded in red and embroidered at the borders with gold red beans and vines, a sash of darker rose tied in a soft flat bow, a drifting rose gauze over-robe; a single red bean on a thin red silk string at her throat. Hands and objects: a rose-silk fan on bamboo ribs in her right hand, opened only a hand's width so that the ribs show; the left hand outstretched toward the guest, palm up, in welcome; a ring of rose jade on a finger. Power: a faint teal Water mist and a few rose-gold motes float in the fan's shadow, soft and low. Background: a carved red-lacquer doorway with a hanging silk lantern and the glowing dark of a hall behind, blurred. Light: warm lantern glow from the upper left, pink on her cheeks, a soft gold rim light. Expression: laughing, welcoming, calculating beneath.

people.imagined: The garden's poison kitchen at night. He is rendering red beans over a low fire with his toad-skin gloves on, stained teeth bared at the stirring spoon, entirely silent, a squat shape beside the pot.
people.subject: The moment: crouched beside a low fire stirring a black iron pot with a long wooden spoon, his stained teeth showing in a concentrated grimace. Face (most important: toad-skin gloves and stained teeth): a squat, wide, flat face with a heavy brow, small deep-set black eyes, a flat wide nose, a thick-lipped mouth open to show brown-stained teeth in the concentration of stirring, a stubble of black beard; about forty. Hair: black, cropped short, a strip of red silk tied round the forehead. Body: short, thick, barrel-chested, heavy-shouldered, sitting low on his heels, utterly still except for the arm. Clothing: a robe of deep red-brown silk with crossed collars, darker wide sleeves tied back at the elbow with red cord, the borders embroidered with dull-gold red beans and vines, a wide dark sash, blotched with old stains but whole and neat; a red bean on a thin red silk string at the throat. Hands and objects: gloves of mottled green-brown toad skin to the elbow, plainly warty; the right holds a long spoon, the left a flat paddle; beside him a row of small jade-green jars with wax seals and a heap of red-and-black beans. Power: a dark green Wood-and-poison vapour rises from the pot, curling with faint green motes, and sparks of crimson glow on the gloves. Background: a low stone kitchen under a dark roof, bunches of dried herbs, wisps of pale spirit-mist, blurred. Light: red firelight from the lower left on the face and gloves, the rest in deep shadow, a thin green rim light. Expression: teeth bared in a silent grimace, eyes narrowed on the pot, counting its worth.

people.imagined: A rainy lane in Thu Trì at night. He has just won at dice and is standing a round for the carriers, a coin walking across his knuckles that stops only when he is lying, a lacquer box tucked under his arm.
people.subject: The moment: under a dripping awning at night he walks a coin across the back of his knuckles, grinning broadly at friends out of frame, a lacquer box under his arm. Face: a lean, cheerful, wide-jawed face with a quick easy grin, bright black eyes with crinkles at the corners, a broken nose, a short stubble; rain beads on his forehead; about thirty-five. Hair: black and wet, in a rough knot with a loose tail held by a red silk ribbon. Body: wiry, loose-limbed, one hip cocked, the weight relaxed. Clothing: a dark red silk jacket with a wide stand collar and gold toggles over a pale rose inner robe, borders embroidered with small gold red beans, a short cloak of translucent oiled gauze over the shoulders, a dark sash, rolled trousers; a red bean on a thin red silk string at the throat. Hands and objects: a single coin with a square hole travelling over his knuckles, catching the light; a small red lacquer box with a gold line, tied with red cord, under the left arm; on the right wrist a jade dice-cup bracelet. Power: a few teal Water motes drift in the falling rain, low and faint. Background: a narrow wet lane glowing with red paper lanterns, a stall with steaming bowls, a crowd of carriers in rain-cloaks, blurred, mist on the stones. Light: red lantern glow from the upper left, glistening on wet stone, a soft pearly rim light from the rain. Expression: a wide bright grin, eyes shining, a careless gleam of risk.

people.imagined: The red-bean garden in the afternoon, a tall man in a gardener's apron, the calluses of a swordsman on his right hand, tying up a bean vine; he has heard a footstep and half-turns with the ease of someone who has made peace.
people.subject: The moment: in a garden he ties a bean vine to a trellis with a strip of grey silk, then half-turns his head toward a sound with a calm look. Face: a long, tanned, calm face with a high forehead, level steady brown eyes, thick straight brows, a straight nose, a gentle mouth, deep smile lines; a thin scar through the left brow; about forty-five. Hair: black with grey at the sides, in a plain knot with a strip of red silk, stray hairs sticking out. Body: tall, broad-shouldered, long arms, the easy upright stance of a trained swordsman gone soft at the edges. Clothing: a servant's garden dress, plain but clean and graceful: a long pale linen-grey silk robe with crossed collars, an undyed gauze sash tied at the waist, sleeves rolled, a faint red-bean border at the hem, a banana-leaf hat hanging on his back; a red bean on a thin red silk string at the throat. Hands and objects: the right hand has the hard flat calluses of a sword grip along the palm and fingers, plainly visible against a pale green vine; a long plain sword in a worn black scabbard leans against a trellis post, partly covered by a cloth; the left hand holds the cloth strip. Power: a faint warm red-orange Fire glow at the sword's hilt, held low and quiet, with a few drifting embers. Background: rows of tall trellises hung with red beans, a low sun through mist, blurred. Light: warm golden afternoon light from the upper left, haze and a soft rim light on his shoulders. Expression: soft eyes and an easy half smile, shoulders loose, at peace with whoever comes.

people.imagined: Night, in the picking shed, no lamp. She is sorting red beans by touch in the dark, ripe from poison, quick and sure, her face turned toward nothing in particular, her hands doing the work.
people.subject: The moment: sitting in the dark sorting red beans between her fingers, her face turned up and still, her hands moving fast. Face (most important: a plain boiled-turnip face and wonderful hands): a round, flat, rather homely face, pale and pocked, with small eyes set wide, a bulbous nose, thick pale brows, a wide mouth in an open calm; about eighteen. Hair: dull brown, in two plain braids tied with grey silk string. Body: short, round-shouldered, stout, sitting cross-legged, still but for the arms. Clothing: the simplest graceful silk of an outer disciple: a pale grey-green silk jacket and long skirt-robe with crossed collars, sleeves rolled to the elbow, a narrow red border embroidered with tiny red beans, a banana-leaf hat on her back; a red bean on a thin red silk string at the throat. Hands and objects: long, slender, beautiful hands, quick as birds, in contrast to the face: one hand holds a bright red bean between two fingers while the other pushes a speckled one aside into a separate heap; two flat baskets in front of her, one full of bright beans and the other of dull ones. Power: a soft green Wood glimmer rests round the bright beans only. Background: a dark shed with open roof beams and a trellis outside, blurred, a pale moon in mist. Light: a thin silver moonlight from the upper left lights her hands and the beans only, a faint blue rim light on her hair. Expression: a still, open face lost in the work, certain of her fingers.

people.imagined: The forest path to the manor at dusk. She scatters a handful of red beans across the path with a quick turn of the wrist, her pocket clicking like a dice cup, so that a stranger will see them and turn back.
people.subject: The moment: on a forest path at dusk she flicks a handful of bright red beans from her open palm across the dirt, looking over her shoulder. Face: a young, bright, alert face with a pointed chin, wide dark eyes, arched brows lifted, a quick small mouth with a secret in it, a scratch on the cheek; about twenty-one. Hair: black, in a long braid tied with red silk, a banana-leaf hat hanging from her neck. Body: slim, quick, light, crouched, ready to spring. Clothing: the plain graceful silk of an outer disciple: a pale grey silk jacket with crossed collars and wide sleeves, short rose-grey over-skirts trimmed in red-bean embroidery, straw shoes; the right pocket swollen and sagging with beans; a red bean on a thin red silk string at the throat. Hands and objects: red beans in the air like bright red drops against the dark earth; the other hand holds a bamboo hairpin needle; at her belt a small silk pouch. A few beans already scattered in the dust behind her, a loose braid-end caught on a twig, her breath quick through a half-smile. Power: a faint green Wood shimmer at the beans, a few tiny green motes. Background: a dim forest path of tall trees in drifting mist, a distant lantern glow, blurred. Light: low violet dusk light from the left, the beans glowing like small embers, a soft rim light. Expression: a half smile hiding a secret, chin up, eyes darting back along the path.

people.imagined: The misty bridge of Yên Kiều, as it vanishes in rain. He sits on the parapet in wet wool, one boot tied on with cord, watching the road and counting what each guest carries, ready to send word.
people.subject: The moment: seated on the stone parapet of a bridge half swallowed by mist, he watches the road with a shifty, intent look, one foot swinging. Face: a thin, sharp, sallow face with quick restless eyes, thin brows, a long nose, a small clever mouth, a cowlick; wet hair plastered to the forehead; about sixteen. Hair: dark brown, wet, a cowlick at the crown. Body: thin, lanky, slouched on the wall, long limbs folded. Clothing: a poor outer disciple's dress, kept clean: a damp grey silk jacket with crossed collars and a narrow red-bean border, rain-dark at the shoulders, a rope-and-silk belt, rolled trousers, one worn boot and the other tied on with a cord; a straw hat; a red bean on a thin red thread at the throat. Hands and objects: a short bamboo stick with which he scratches marks on the stone; a bag of dried beans at his hip; a small bell on a string hung from the wall. Background: a stone bridge fading into spirit-mist, the dark shape of a traveller on the road far off, tall wet trees, blurred. Light: pale diffuse silver light from the upper left, soft glow in the mist, faint rim light on the wet hat. Expression: eyes sliding sideways, a thin smile that could turn either way. A little green Wood mist drifts at his feet, barely visible.

people.imagined: The gracious door, with her patron out of the room. She smiles brilliantly at a guest while tugging her rose cuff, as she does whenever a sentence is not true, without noticing; she is learning whom to smile at.
people.subject: The moment: smiling brilliantly at a guest while her other hand tugs the cuff of her rose silk sleeve. Face: a round, pretty, bright face with large dark eyes with long lashes, arched brows, a button nose, a wide smile of perfect white teeth, dimples; the smile just a shade too wide; about twenty-four. Hair: black, in a high glossy knot with a rose silk ribbon, one red lacquered comb and a small silver pin with a coral bean. Body: soft, plump-armed, graceful, with a slight forward tilt in the hips as she bows. Clothing: graceful rose-pink silk of the door's apprentices: layered crossed collars, an inner collar of pale rose gauze, wide sleeves with a deeper rose border embroidered with tiny gold red beans, a sash of dark red brocade, the cuff of the left sleeve slightly crumpled where it is tugged; a red bean on a thin red silk string at the throat. Hands and objects: the right hand pinches and tugs the rose cuff of the left sleeve; the left carries a small round tray with a white jade tea cup, empty; a folded rose-silk fan in the sash. Power: a faint teal Water shimmer round the cup, nothing more. Background: the glowing red-lacquer doorway with a hanging silk lantern, a table of cups and a pot, blurred. Light: warm lantern glow from the upper left, a soft gold rim light on her cheek. Expression: a dazzling smile with hungry eyes behind it, a shade too wide.

people.imagined: The manor's front steps. He is proudly counting off his family tree on his fingers and has lost the thread at the fifth name; a heavy jade ring is on his thumb. He is thrilled to be taken in so fast.
people.subject: The moment: standing on stone steps, counting on his fingers with a proud lifted chin, frowning as he loses his place. Face: a long, handsome, haughty, boyish face with a high nose, bright proud brown eyes, straight thick brows, a mouth ready to boast, a pimple on the chin; about seventeen. Hair: black and glossy, in a topknot with a green jade pin and a short red silk ribbon. Body: tall, lanky, shoulders back, chin lifted, one foot forward. Clothing: a young disciple's finest silk, slightly too grand for the place: layered robes of pale green silk over a rose inner collar, crossed high collars, wide sleeves with silver-thread cuffs and red-bean embroidery at the border, a belt of green silk cord with a jade hook, black boots; a red bean on a thin red silk string at the throat. Hands and objects: a heavy jade ring far too big worn on the right thumb; the left hand's fingers held up and counted down on the right, four fingers already folded; at his side a slim sword in a green scabbard with a carved bean-shaped guard. The jade ring slips on his thumb as he counts, a few red petals cling to his boots, and his ears have gone slightly pink with effort. Power: a faint green Wood glimmer about the sword's scabbard, small and unsteady. Background: the red-lacquer gate of a manor and a path of red petals in light mist, blurred, a gardener bent over a trellis. Light: bright soft spirit-light from the upper left, a gentle rim light on his topknot. Expression: chin high and brows knit, boastful and bold, a flicker of being lost.

people.imagined: The year 1062, in the hall, at the moment he takes the sword down from its rack. A handsome ambitious man looks over his shoulder with a quick smile, confident, one hand already round the hilt.
people.subject: The moment: memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened and softened, a pale mist at the borders. A handsome man glances over his shoulder with a confident smile, his hand on the hilt of a sword half drawn from a wall rack. Face: a handsome, lean, smiling face with high cheekbones, bright restless dark eyes, a straight nose, a full mouth in a charming smile, a thin moustache and a short trimmed beard; about thirty-five. Hair: black, tied in a high topknot with a red silk cord and a small gold crown-pin, one lock falling over the brow. Body: tall, slim, broad-shouldered, graceful, dressed for stealth. Clothing: a disciple's robes of fine dark-red silk with three crossed layers, a high collar with black trim, borders and wide sleeves embroidered in faded gold with red beans and vines, a sash of black brocade with a bronze clasp, a short dark gauze cloak over one shoulder; a red bean on a thin red silk string at his throat. Hands and objects: the right hand grips the hilt of a slender sword with a bright red scabbard, drawn a hand's breadth to show a gleam of steel; the left holds the cloak closed; on the wall behind a rack with a second empty bracket. Power: a faint red-orange Fire glow runs along the bare blade, muted as old pigment. Background: a dim hall of red lacquer pillars and hanging silk lanterns, drifting incense mist, blurred. Light: lantern glow from the upper left, the whole picture aged, faded and softened with a faint pale rim light. Expression: a charming sidelong smile, eyes bright with hunger and no loyalty in them.

people.imagined: Night in the gardeners' long house, a qin on her knees. She sings the Thorn and Ink Verses half a tone flat, thinking no one listens, while the gardeners drift to sleep around her and she wonders which would leave.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a mat at night with a qin across her knees, singing softly with her eyes half closed, a few sleepers visible behind her. Face: a calm, pale, oval face with a high forehead, level grey eyes, fine straight brows, a small mouth open softly in song, smooth cool skin; about forty. Hair: black, in a low coil at the nape with a bamboo pin and a red bean on a thin string woven in. Body: slender, still, upright, hands moving only at the fingertips. Clothing: flowing layered silk of the sect's inner disciples: an inner collar of pale rose, a middle robe of soft grey-green silk and an outer robe of deep green gauze with wide sleeves, crossed collars and borders embroidered in gold with red beans and thorn-vines, a black silk sash, a banana-leaf hat hung on the wall behind her; a red bean on a thin red silk string at the throat. Hands and objects: a plain dark qin with seven strings laid across her knees, one hand plucking a string; a small clay lamp on the floor beside her; a bundle of thorny vines on a shelf. Power: soft green Wood light and fine green motes rise from the strings with each note and settle on the sleepers. Background: a long low room with rows of sleeping gardeners wrapped in blankets, a paper window with a pale moon, thin mist, blurred. Light: a small lamp from the lower right, warm on her chin, the rest in silvery dimness, a soft rim light on her sleeve. Expression: a smooth, distant face, steady eyes with a faint crease of worry.

people.imagined: At the gracious door, pouring the second cup, her right side turned to the guest so they will not see the left ear. She watches the cup, smiling, on a nod she has been waiting for.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a lit doorway in profile, her right side turned toward the guest, she lifts a two-chambered clay teapot and pours into a white cup, smiling. Face (most important: the missing left earlobe): a soft, round, pleasant face with warm brown eyes, gently arched brows, a small nose, a small smiling mouth; on the left side the earlobe is plainly gone, a smooth little stump; about forty. Hair: black, in a high smooth knot with a pin of red lacquer and a small gold bean ornament, a loose lock over the left ear. Body: plump, graceful, turned side-on, shoulders soft. Clothing: layered robes of rose and red silk with crossed collars, an under-collar of white gauze, wide sleeves tipped back and embroidered along the borders with gold red beans and vines, a broad sash of crimson brocade, a small red bean on a thin red silk string at the throat. Hands and objects: the right hand holds the lid of the red clay teapot; the left pours a thin stream into a white cup; a small book bound in red silk tucked in her sash; a jade pendant on a silk cord. Power: a faint teal Water glow lies in the poured stream, small and calm. Background: a lacquered red doorway with a glowing silk lantern, a low table with two cups, soft incense mist, blurred. Light: warm lantern glow from the right, lighting the unharmed side of the face, a gentle rim light along her shoulder. Expression: sweet, devoted to the nod, hiding.

people.imagined: Night in the sorting shed, her hands held over a lamp flame. She feels nothing; the red on her fingertips never washes out. She glances up because a gardener across the room is looking at her as if he knew her.
people.subject: The moment: sitting at a sorting table at night, her hands held out flat over a lamp's flame, she glances up toward a man across the room. Face: a quiet, plain, narrow face with a long nose, thoughtful grey eyes, straight pale brows, a closed patient mouth, a freckle by the lip; about twenty. Hair: light brown, in one braid hanging over the shoulder tied with red silk, a banana-leaf hat on the table. Body: slender, upright, composed, shoulders level. Clothing: the simplest graceful silk of an outer disciple: a pale grey silk jacket and long robe with crossed collars, sleeves rolled, a narrow border of tiny red-bean embroidery, a soft grey sash; a red bean on a thin red silk string at the throat. Hands and objects: both hands held steady over the lamp flame; the fingertips are stained a deep permanent red like cinnabar, plainly visible, as if dyed; on the table two flat baskets of beans, one red, one dull. Power: a soft green Wood glow and a faint red shimmer gather at her fingertips. Background: a bare shed with a beam roof, a row of baskets, and a dim figure of a tall man in garden robes at the far end, thin mist, blurred. Light: the lamp from the lower left lights her hands and chin, silver moonlight at the window, a soft rim light. Expression: a quiet face, lifted brows, an unhurried curiosity.

people.imagined: The gracious door. A guest has stepped in; she is pouring the first cup, weighing the guest with her eyes while her smile comes a beat late; she has learned to smile for a killer and not yet for a pretty one.
people.subject: The moment: at the door she pours the first cup, her eyes weighing the guest up and down while the smile has not yet arrived. Face: a young, pretty, sharp face with large calculating dark eyes, thin arched brows, a straight small nose, a small mouth that smiles slowly, a beat after the eyes; about eighteen. Hair: black, in a high knot with two red lacquered pins, a few loose strands at the nape. Body: slim, upright, careful, the elbows neatly tucked. Clothing: graceful layered silk of red and rose, fitted, with crossed collars, a white gauze inner collar, wide sleeves with borders of tiny gold-thread red beans, a darker crimson sash, a rose fan tucked in; a red bean on a thin red silk string at the throat. Hands and objects: a white porcelain cup held on a little saucer in the left hand; a red clay teapot in the right, pouring a thin amber stream; a small silver ring on the middle finger. A faint flush of heat from the tea warms her cheeks, her sleeves are neatly gathered, and the steam rises in a single straight line past her eyes. Power: a faint teal Water shimmer round the cup, very small. Background: a red doorway with a glowing silk lantern, a low table with a second cup, soft mist, blurred. Light: warm lantern glow from the upper left, a gentle pink rim light. Expression: a cool appraising look, eyes hungry for a higher seat.

people.imagined: The Night Rain Market, a stall under an awning. A buyer in toad-skin gloves offers silver; he covers his gold-edged front tooth with his hand at the price, thinking of what to tell his friend.
people.subject: The moment: at a stall under an awning at night he covers his mouth with his hand when a price is named, a gleam of gold at the fingers. Face (most important: the gold-edged front tooth): a round, honest, pleasant face with a broad nose, friendly brown eyes, thick straight brows, a wide mouth with one front tooth edged in bright gold, showing at the fingers; about twenty-three. Hair: black, in a short topknot under a woven straw hat. Body: stocky, easy, with a carrier's wide strong shoulders. Clothing: a clean dark-grey silk jacket with crossed collars and a red cord round the collar, a short cloak of translucent oiled gauze, a border of small red-bean embroidery, trousers rolled to the shin, straw shoes; a red bean on a thin red thread at the throat. Hands and objects: the left hand over the mouth, the right holding a small red lacquer box with a gold line, tied with red cord; a heavy carrying yoke leans against the stall. Power: a few teal Water motes drift in the rain, barely visible. Background: a stall with other lacquer boxes in rows under a glowing awning, rain on the cloth, a figure with green-brown toad-skin gloves at the edge, spirit-mist, blurred. Light: red lantern glow from the upper left, wet gleams, a soft rim light on the straw hat. Expression: a guarded look over the hand, kind eyes unsure what to say.

people.imagined: The poison kitchen, grinding beans for the pastes with cloth wraps on both hands, smelling of clove from ten paces, and never touching bread bare-handed; he looks up sharply at a sound at the door.
people.subject: The moment: grinding red beans in a stone mortar with both hands wrapped in thick white silk cloth, looking up sharply at a sound at a door. Face: a lean, careful, pale face with narrow suspicious dark eyes, thin dark brows, a long nose, a tight mouth, a small crease of worry; sweat at the temples; about twenty-eight. Hair: black, tied back under a white silk cloth wrapped round the head, a few damp strands. Body: lean, wiry, hunched over the stone, shoulders tight. Clothing: a clean robe of grey-rose silk with crossed collars and sleeves tied back at the wrist with red cord, a long dark sash, borders embroidered with tiny red beans and stained brown at the hem, a white cloth tied over the lower face and pulled down to the chin; a red bean on a thin red silk string at the throat. Hands and objects: both hands wrapped in layers of white cloth, tied at the wrist with red cord, round a heavy stone pestle in a stone mortar full of crushed dark red paste; a row of jade-green clay jars and a pile of whole red-and-black beans; a bunch of cloves hung from the belt. Power: a dark green Wood haze rises from the paste, with faint green motes and a red glimmer. Background: a low stone kitchen with a black hearth and hanging herbs, wisps of vapour, blurred. Light: red-orange firelight from the lower left, a pale spirit-glow on the cloth, a thin rim light. Expression: eyes darting to the door, jaw tight, guarding what he serves.

people.imagined: The door at dusk, between guests. She touches the single red bean knotted at the nape of her neck with a hand, saving it for the guide who drinks one cup a month and never asks for a second.
people.subject: The moment: standing quietly at a doorway between guests, one hand lifted to the back of her neck to touch a thread. Face: a quiet, pale, delicate face with large calm brown eyes, soft straight brows, a small straight nose, a small closed mouth; about twenty-two. Hair: black, in a smooth low coil, with a single bright red bean tied on a thread at the nape where the knot shows, a hair-thread of red silk wound round the coil. Body: slender, upright, reserved, hands light. Clothing: graceful robes of soft rose silk with crossed plain collars and wide sleeves, a sash of dark red brocade, the borders kept simple with only a thin line of gold-thread vines; the red bean at the nape is her only ornament, and she wears none at the throat. Hands and objects: her right hand raised to the thread at her nape; the left holds an empty white jade cup on a saucer; a folded rose fan in the sash. Power: a faint green Wood shimmer round the red bean at her nape. Background: the red-lacquer doorway and a violet dusk sky, a silk lantern lit, a path with a tall shadowy figure walking away in mist, blurred.
